extracted.name: Holiday Punch
extracted.description: This refreshing holiday punch is made with cranberry juice, pineapple juice, and ginger ale for the perfect Christmas punch for a crowd.
instruction_lines: Combine sugar, cranberry juice, pineapple juice, and almond extract in a large container, mix together and refrigerate until chilled.
To serve, pour juice mixture into a punch bowl. Stir in ginger ale.
